title: Vinto landfill closure blockade begun before January
notes: The January 9 contemporary newspaper PDF says police intervened the previous day after more than two months of closure. This is a pre-January lead, with the exact start and continuous public attendance unresolved. Only the front-page mention and short radar item were read; no January-start candidate was created.

title: Earlier K’ara K’ara school-basket blockade
notes: The retrospective chronology describes a December 14–22 assembly, then a pause for the holidays after an agreement over school-food baskets. This is an antecedent link; January continuation is not established. The later January 25 municipal-demands blockade is not automatically the same physical episode.
